options.reason: Absolute deaths provide a direct, transparent measure of the motorist fatality burden, though not a mileage-adjusted risk.
options.answer: Recorded motorist deaths declined from 110 in 2013 to 81 in 2025 (26.4% lower), but the data cannot establish whether deaths per mile driven declined.
options.interpretation: This framing answers whether the number of motorists killed in reported NYC crashes changed, and the chart shows 110 deaths in 2013 versus 81 in 2025. A death count is a defensible description of the observed fatality burden, but it is not a risk rate because no miles-driven exposure is present. It therefore leaves the question of motorist deaths per mile unanswered. It uses complete calendar years 2013–2025 and excludes 2012 (100,545 rows, 4.43% of file) and 2026 (36,424 rows, 1.61% of file) as outside the requested interval; no in-range rows are omitted for NULL required values, and no included year is partial.

options.metric: Share of reported crash records with at least one motorist death
options.denominator: All reported crash records in each year
options.reason: The share of crashes involving a motorist death normalizes fatal crashes by reported crash volume, offering a crash-level severity measure.
options.answer: The share of crash records with a motorist death changed from 0.050% in 2013 to 0.088% in 2025 (+0.038 percentage points), but this is not risk per mile driven.
options.interpretation: This framing answers how often a reported crash record involved at least one motorist death, with 0.050% in 2013 and 0.088% in 2025 shown. Using all reported crash records as the denominator gives a defensible crash-level fatality measure, but it is not exposure-adjusted. It leaves the per-mile risk question unanswered because annual miles driven are absent from this file. It uses complete calendar years 2013–2025 and excludes 2012 (100,545 rows, 4.43% of file) and 2026 (36,424 rows, 1.61% of file) as outside the requested interval; no in-range rows are omitted for NULL required values, and no included year is partial.
